title: Contacts: your first app
summary: Build a small contacts app from an empty folder: companies and the people at them. Add a field later, give a lead a one-click button, decide who sees what, and call it all over the API.

title: An online shop with orders
summary: Categories, products with optimised pictures and prices in a currency, and orders whose items are edited as a table inside the order, with a total the app keeps. Then a public page of what is on sale.

title: A student app
summary: Teachers, courses, students and the enrolments that join them, teachers who see only their own classes, a public sign-up form that proves the student's email address, and a teacher told when a student drops out.

title: A billing app
summary: The client billing system JB builds on stage at GopherCon Africa: clients, their projects, invoices and payments, in shillings. A phone number held to Uganda, a billing cycle only a recurring project has, a gallery, and 25,000 invoices to try it on.
